svg.text: Alibi replay: real error against the ± it showed
Above the line the ± held the truth; below it the ± was too small (misleading). Made by tools/check_spoof.js.
dead reckoning on the real logs (every 2nd s): 917 dots, 2.4 % below the line
GPS back after a synthetic outage: 819 dots, 3.4 % below the line
Alibi under simulated attack: 84284 dots, 14.7 % below the line
